# EDIT Saffron

> Meet EDIT Saffron, FTC Team 22310 at Lo-Ellen Park in Greater Sudbury. Student-built robots, hands-on engineering, and a community helping us go further.

EDIT Saffron is an independent FIRST® Tech Challenge robotics team based at Lo-Ellen Park Secondary School in Greater Sudbury, Ontario. The public site covers the team's students, engineering disciplines, competition calendar, outreach, and contact information.

## Public pages

- [EDIT Saffron · FTC Team 22310](https://22310.ca/): Meet EDIT Saffron, FTC Team 22310 at Lo-Ellen Park in Greater Sudbury. Student-built robots, hands-on engineering, and a community helping us go further.
- [Our team](https://22310.ca/team/): Meet the students behind EDIT Saffron, FTC Team 22310 at Lo-Ellen Park Secondary School in Greater Sudbury. Design, Automation, Reach, Trades, and Strategy.
- [Sponsor the team](https://22310.ca/sponsors/): Support student robotics in Greater Sudbury. Explore sponsorship, materials, services, and mentorship opportunities with EDIT Saffron, FTC Team 22310.
- [Events](https://22310.ca/events/): Explore the EDIT Saffron public calendar. Search robotics meetings, practices, outreach and competitions, and save dates to your calendar.
- [Contact](https://22310.ca/contact/): Get in touch with EDIT Saffron in Greater Sudbury. Talk sponsorship, mentorship, outreach, getting involved, or a visit with FTC Team 22310.
- [Partnership brief](https://22310.ca/sponsors/brief/): A printable overview of EDIT Saffron, FTC Team 22310, and ways to support student robotics in Greater Sudbury.

## Public-site scope

This file describes only the public website at https://22310.ca/. Use the linked pages as the source of truth for current public information.
